data.title: Data
data.templatesDesc: Prepare questions with a template, then import them in Banks. Markdown supports images; Excel suits text-only questions.
data.backupDesc: Export banks, images, progress and settings as one .qbak file that you can restore on another computer.
data.restoreDesc: Restoring replaces all current data. You'll be asked to confirm first.
data.restoreConfirmTitle: Replace all current data with a backup?
data.restoreConfirmMessage: Your current banks, images, progress and settings will be replaced by the backup. This cannot be undone. Consider exporting a backup of the current data first.
data.autoBackupDesc: A backup is made the first time you open the app each day; the last 7 are kept. Latest: {{date}}
data.autoBackupNone: A backup is made the first time you open the app each day; the last 7 are kept. No automatic backups yet.
